literal: Than fate, what things of great power exist? Even if one plans another way, itself will stand ahead.
translation: What is of greater power than fate? Even if one plans another way to bypass it, fate itself will arrive first and stand ahead.
modern: ஊழை விடப் பெரிய வலிமை உடையவை வேறு எவை உள்ளன? அதைத் தடுப்பதற்கு வேறு ஒரு வழியை ஆராய்ந்து திட்டமிட்டாலும், ஊழ் தானே முந்திக்கொண்டு வந்து நிற்கும்.
explanation: This couplet asserts the supreme power of fate over human designs. The author rhetorically asks what could possibly possess greater strength than fate. Even if a person tries to devise an alternative plan or countermeasure to bypass it, fate itself will anticipate that move and manifest beforehand. The key words 'சூழினும்' (even if planned) and 'முந்துறும்' (will stand ahead) highlight the futility of trying to outsmart destiny, as the very attempt is forestalled by fate.
